title: Scoped sponsored render queue and finalization for the assigned Illinois route
dependencyClosed: B-SPONSORED-TRANSACTION (RETURN-02 outcomeB.remainingDependencies[1]) at the database layer only

route.automaticSibling: il-prostitution-j-auto is not registered and cannot be sponsored

generalisationApproach: A scoped registration table plus a parameterised finalizer that the existing Mississippi entry point delegates to. No MS/event restriction was removed from the existing finalizer: its literals were written into a registration row and the Illinois route was added as a second row. No consumer payment is manufactured and no application-side credit or provenance write is introduced.

operationsForCodex.purpose: Replace the explicit refusal at src/lib/expungement-ai/packet-generation.ts lines 192-208 ("Verified sponsored render enqueue is unavailable for this route."). Call as service_role.
operationsForCodex.name: public.enqueue_verified_sponsored_packet_render
operationsForCodex.signature: public.enqueue_verified_sponsored_packet_render(p_route_key text, p_session_id uuid, p_packet_id uuid, p_route_id text, p_renderer_kind text, p_renderer_version text, p_source_sha256 text, p_profile_id text, p_profile_version text, p_input_hash text, p_briefcase_item_id uuid, p_person_id uuid, p_matter_id uuid, p_max_attempts integer, p_expected_consumer_auth_user_id uuid, p_expected_verification_hash text, p_render_packet jsonb, p_render_input_payload jsonb)

input.p_session_id: the claimed pending result's anonymous_session_id; never a value from the request body
input.p_packet_id / p_render_packet / p_render: exactly preparePersonalizedPacket(...).payload.renderPacket and .renderInputPayload plus its packetId; the payload's routeId, trackId, packetFamilyId, specificationId, specificationVersion, specificationSha256 and snapshot.jurisdiction/pathwayId/selectedTrackId must equal the registration row
input.p_expected_verification_hash: the current protected verification hash the caller read

operationsForCodex.output: setof public.packet_render_jobs (one row). The row carries sponsored_route_key, sponsored_session_id, sponsored_clinic_event_id, sponsored_consumer_briefcase_item_id, sponsored_consumer_auth_user_id and sponsored_verification_hash. partner_id is derived inside the function from the clinic event's partner; consumer_* columns stay null so the existing queue mode rule is untouched.
operationsForCodex.failureMode: raises; the messages are 'sponsored render route is not registered', 'sponsored render payload binding mismatch', 'sponsored render route binding mismatch', 'sponsored render verification changed', 'sponsored render authority missing: <reason>', 'sponsored render matter binding mismatch', 'sponsored render input payload is immutable'. Idempotent: an identical call returns the same job.
operationsForCodex.idempotency: packet_id + input_hash through the existing enqueue_packet_render_job; two identical or concurrent calls yield one job

operationsForCodex.purpose: Atomic sponsored finalization after the worker validated the bytes.
operationsForCodex.name: public.finalize_sponsored_packet_generation_for_route
operationsForCodex.signature: public.finalize_sponsored_packet_generation_for_route(p_route_key text, p_session_id uuid, p_briefcase_item_id uuid, p_expected_verification_hash text, p_packet_artifact jsonb, p_render_job_id uuid default null)

input.p_packet_artifact: the ConsumerPacketArtifactRefs object buildGradeAArtifact already returns; provider, source, contentType, packetId, verificationHash, packetSpecificationId, packetSpecificationVersion, packetSpecificationSha256, packetFamily, artifactSha256 (64 hex), pageCount and documentCount are all checked against the registration row
input.p_render_job_id: the job id from the enqueue; when supplied the job must be this participant's own sponsored job for this route/session/verification, already artifact_validated or delivered, eligible, and its output_sha256 must equal artifact.artifactSha256

operationsForCodex.output: table(ok boolean, recorded boolean, counted_as text, reason text). counted_as is 'included' | 'overage' | 'capped' | 'not_counted'. reason is null on a first success and otherwise one of invalid_input, route_not_registered, wrong_item, verification_mismatch, wrong_owner, wrong_matter, wrong_jurisdiction_or_route, wrong_session, wrong_partner, sponsorship_inactive, clinic_scope_mismatch, malformed_artifact, render_job_mismatch, already_finalized, artifact_conflict, sponsorship_already_consumed, event_sponsorship_exhausted, no_entitlement, paused_at_cap, cap_reached_no_overage.
operationsForCodex.effects: one clinic-mode allowance unit (partner_entitlement.screenings_used or the overage counters), the session slot moved claimed -> consumed, one rcap_record_events row, one rcap_screening_analytics_events packet_generated row, one consumer_packet_artifact_provenance row with entitlement_source 'partner_sponsorship' owned by the participant and naming the render job, the Briefcase item mirrored to Ready, and the clinic case moved to packet_ready. All in one transaction; a downstream failure raises and rolls the whole thing back.

operationsForCodex.purpose: Read-only pre-check the route handler may use before offering the sponsored action.

operationsForCodex.signature: public.sponsored_packet_render_authority(p_route_key text, p_session_id uuid, p_briefcase_item_id uuid, p_consumer_auth_user_id uuid)
operationsForCodex.output: table(valid boolean, reason text, partner_slug text, partner_id uuid, clinic_event_id uuid, clinic_case_id uuid)

coverage: happy path: sponsored enqueue with no consumer payment, the worker verification guard admits the job, runWorkerCycle finalizes with accounting 'consumed' and eligibility 'eligible', finalization consumes exactly one clinic-mode credit and writes participant-owned provenance naming the render job, and the owner's artifact authority reads Ready while another participant reads absent
failure and retry: a failed render consumes nothing; after requeue the same job is reused, finalizes once, and consumes exactly one credit with one ledger row

concurrent and duplicate: two concurrent identical enqueues yield one job; two concurrent identical finalizations record once; an identical finalization retry returns already_finalized without a second consumption; a changed artifact byte is artifact_conflict
wrong owner: an enqueue naming another participant is refused; finalization refuses a claimed source whose owner differs
wrong event: an enqueue whose clinic case sits under another event is refused; finalization refuses an event belonging to another program
stale verification: a verification changed after enqueue stops the job at the guard and finalization returns verification_mismatch; refinalizing under the new hash is refused as render_job_mismatch

invalid authority: an unregistered route (IL:il-prostitution-j-auto) is refused at both enqueue and finalization; wrong family, wrong track and wrong specification digest render inputs are refused; the render input is immutable; the sponsored binding on an existing job is immutable; a sponsored finalization refuses another participant's job

creditSemantics: Two existing mechanisms, each used unchanged and each consumed once. The queue's phase-49/50/52 partner packet credit is consumed by finalize_packet_render_job because the job is a partner job, exactly as the existing sponsored shape does. The clinic-mode allowance (partner_entitlement.screenings_used, or the overage counters when the partner is over cap with overage enabled) is consumed once by the finalizer, exactly as the Mississippi finalizer does. Neither is consumed twice on a retry, a duplicate request or a repeat download, and no consumer payment row is created anywhere on this path.
